dedupe_keys.name: hdb resale flat prices singapore public housing 1990 onwards

description: The Housing & Development Board publishes resale transactions of public housing flats in Singapore as a collection of five datasets on the government open data portal. The data run from 1990; before March 2012 they are based on the approval date of the resale and from March 2012 on the registration date. The current dataset, from January 2017, gives month, town, flat type, block, street name, storey range, floor area, flat model, lease commencement date, remaining lease and resale price, and was updated on 26 September 2026. Coverage: HDB resale transactions in Singapore. Access: CSV downloads and the data.gov.sg API, free. Licence: Singapore Open Data Licence. Caveats: the block and street give the building but not the unit, the reference date changed in 2012, and new sales and rentals are not included. Simulation uses are block-level housing values, age and lease for exposure, relocation and redevelopment models. Related records: the URA Data Service for private housing.
